title: RingedCompletionUnit
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small category with Grothendieck topology $J$, and let $\mathcal O$ be a sheaf of commutative rings. Use its category of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Use the derived categories of [def-weil-pbc-ringed-derived-restriction] and derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. For an augmented complex $\epsilon:K\to\mathcal O[0]$ in the complex encoding of [def-weil-pbc-ringed-extended-cech], define $F_K(E)=R\mathcal Hom(K,E)$. Define the canonical isomorphism $E\to R\mathcal Hom(\mathcal O[0],E)$ by the functorial K-injective resolution and the localization factorization, using evaluation at one, whose invertibility and differential compatibility are [lem-sc-hom-complex-unit-evaluation-is-iso] and [lem-sc-hom-complex-unit-evaluation-comm]. Compose with contravariant precomposition by $\epsilon$ to define $\eta_E:E\to F_K(E)$. The data use actual evaluation maps, not a choice of an unspecified isomorphism.
